content.text:
I submitted **index 11 (Bi 0.466, V 0.534)** as the best composition. It gave a photocurrent of 21.7 µA, the highest of the three I measured.

I spent all three merit measurements next to the 1:1 Bi:V ratio of BiVO₄, the known photoanode phase in this system:

| Index | Bi : V | Photocurrent |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | 0.531 : 0.469 | 0.16 µA |
| **11** | **0.466 : 0.534** | **21.7 µA** |
| 13 | 0.457 : 0.543 | 15.1 µA |

- **Bi-rich side:** photocurrent falls sharply. Index 8 is only slightly Bi-rich but about 100× lower than index 11. My guess is that Bi-rich compositions form other, poorer phases, but I didn't check this.
- **V-rich side:** index 13 has a little more V than index 11 and is already lower. So the best point is likely a slight V excess, around index 11.

I didn't measure the other 12 compositions, which are far from 1:1 on both sides, and I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements. So the phase explanations are unconfirmed, and there's a small chance something unexpected elsewhere in the library performs better.
